source_dataset: string - one of: solidifi, smartbugs, dapscan, defihacklabs, dive, slither_hf
source_code_path: string - relative path to the .sol file in processed/
bytecode_path: string - relative path to compiled bytecode, if compiled; null if not compiled
label: string - one of: vulnerable, benign
vulnerability_types: array of strings - all applicable types from the vocabulary below; empty array only if label is benign
primary_vulnerability_type: string - single primary type for stratified splits / simple classifiers; one of the vocabulary values, or 'none' if benign
compiler_version: string - e.g. 0.8.19, or 'unknown' if not determinable
duplicate_of: string or null - contract_id of an identical/near-identical contract if found
notes: string - anything unusual about this entry
parent_contract_id: string or null - the original, pre-transformation contract_id this entry was derived from. Null for original/seed contracts; set for any augmented/obfuscated variant.
transformation_level: string - one of: lexical, structural, control_flow, data_flow, contract_level, none. 'none' for original/seed contracts.
transformation_techniques: array of strings - specific techniques applied, e.g. ['dead_code_insertion', 'opaque_predicate']. Empty array for original/seed contracts.
obfuscation_severity: string - one of: light, moderate, aggressive, none. 'none' for original/seed contracts.
exploit_verified_after_transform: boolean or null - whether the original exploit/vulnerability was confirmed (e.g. via fork-replay) to still hold after transformation. Null for original/seed contracts or benign entries where this does not apply.

gnn_fields.vulnerable_function_name: string or null - name of the function containing the bug, if determinable
gnn_fields.vulnerable_line_numbers: array of ints or null - source line(s) where the bug lives, if determinable from the source dataset's own annotations (SolidiFI/SmartBugs provide this; DAppSCAN/DeFiHackLabs may not)
gnn_fields.vulnerability_class_id: int - numeric encoding of primary_vulnerability_type via vulnerability_class_id_map

llm_fields.vulnerable_function_snippet: string or null - just the relevant function's code, not the whole contract, useful for shorter prompts
llm_fields.explanation: string or null - a short natural-language reason WHY this is vulnerable; do not auto-generate with an LLM without explicit approval
llm_fields.severity: string or null - low / medium / high / critical, if the source dataset or an audit report provides this

_removed.vulnerability_type: REPLACED by vulnerability_types (list) + primary_vulnerability_type. Do not use the old single-string field.
